about.label: About
about.title: An engineer focused on correctness, performance and systems that matter.
about.p1: I'm a Software Engineering student at the University of Brasília (FCTE), currently in my 6th semester. I work across web development, software in high- and low-level languages, ETL and web scraping, plus data standardization to support decision-making.
about.p2: I have hands-on experience with Docker, AWS and Git, work in agile teams and was awarded at an MLH international hackathon. I like going deep: compilers, graphics engines, blockchain and computer vision in Rust.

rust.note: Rust is my favorite language — Ferris hangs around here.

jobs.intro: Current volunteer teaching assistantship in Software Requirements Engineering, supporting learning and hands-on practice of the field's foundations.
points: Supported students in understanding and applying requirements elicitation, analysis, specification, validation and management.
Answered questions and followed course content, providing guidance through exercises and class discussions.
Maintained an ongoing exchange on the nature of requirements engineering and the decisions that make a product clearer and viable.

jobs.intro: A centralized administration platform and bilingual digital storefront for the Crianex software house.
points: Project leadership and team organization, connecting planning to feature-based delivery.
Documentation of team–client interaction and ceremony cadence, with traceable responsibilities.
FDD + Kanban: roadmap and modeling in Miro; issues, WIP limits and reviews in GitHub Projects.
Asynchronous coordination in Discord and partial and formal client validation each iteration.

jobs.intro: A Brazilian technology consultancy that builds custom software, integrations and digital solutions for companies looking to scale efficiently.
points: Developed and deployed applications and integrations, following deliveries from initial design through production.
Worked with the team to analyze needs, design solutions and evolve features through agile methods.
Maintained a continuous focus on code quality, reliability and maintainability for high-value products.

jobs.intro: A University of Brasília outreach program focused on education, citizenship and quality of life for mature and older adults.
points: Built web-scraping and ETL routines to extract and process public Google Scholar data.
Automated the collection and organization of papers, research interests and professional information from prospective collaborators.
Standardized and delivered the data in Excel workbooks to support researcher outreach and recruitment at UniSER/UnB.

events.text: Representing DW Corp, I shared experiences and challenges from an advanced web project already in production, focused on practical learnings and professional growth.
Award-winning project among 117 projects and 356 participants. A solution for onboarding and understanding large code repositories, with automated analysis and contextual explanations.

events.role: Presentation — IBM Dev Day: Bob in Action
events.text: Presentation of the solution built for the IBM Dev Day: Bob in Action hackathon, exploring AI and development-workflow automation with IBM Bob.

As a team, we developed the proposal and Project Canvas for an intelligent system supporting due diligence, credit-risk analysis and early warnings for delinquency or judicial reorganization at Krill Tech. We defended the solution in a pitch to the event jury.
